Food retail carries the consumer-facing safety duty: fresh-chain quality, supplier verification, recall readiness and waste economics. Telemetry and traceability turn compliance cost into customer trust and margin.

items: Supplier compliance evidence patchwork; risk reactive.

items: Simulate before you cut steel: plant, fleet and product twins with governed physics and data.
Cameras into instruments: inspection, safety and counting at the edge, inside policy.
Fix it before it fails: RUL models wired into planning, spare parts and work orders.

At Agriculture & Food Systems level this capability reads as: silo/supply-chain environment monitoring (quality preserved; losses down). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Programs run on the fixed rhythm below, chosen so progress is legible from week one. The first quarter of the rhythm is verification: weeks 1–2 measure the current metric with your team and lock it by signature. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with your control owner receiving evidence weekly. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and the measured delta against the signed baseline. Gates are binding: miss one and the program stops or redirects with a documented decision.
